value: States that generating writes a Python file named after the Options block's ID (ID + .py) in the same directory as the .grc file; when a flowgraph whose ID is still default is saved as tutorial.grc, GRC sets the ID to tutorial, so the file is tutorial.py (a flowgraph with another ID gives <ID>.py).
edit: P1: GRC 3.10.12's Save As sets an Options ID still at default to the file name, so the file is tutorial.py (a28)

value: Uses a high-pass filter whose gain at 0 Hz is essentially zero: either the High Pass Filter block (firdes.high_pass taps) with the sample rate, a cutoff above 0 Hz but well below the lowest wanted frequency, a transition width and a window, or the DC Blocker block (moving-average high-pass, with its length setting the notch width).
edit: P1: also accept the DC Blocker block, a high-pass filter made for removing DC (a28)

value: States the cost of a very low cutoff (a narrow notch around DC): with the High Pass Filter block, the narrow transition band needs many FIR taps (roughly sample rate / transition width), adding delay and CPU load; with the DC Blocker, a longer delay line narrows the notch but adds group delay (2D-2 samples in the long form, D-1 in the short form). Naming a cheaper alternative (the DC Blocker block or a single-pole IIR running average) is not required for this point.
edit: P3: the DC Blocker's own trade-off earns P3 too, now that P1 accepts it (a28 re-check)
